title: Machine learning selects IGKC and COL4A1 as shared genes in IBD and periodontitis
summary: Differentially expressed genes from GEO datasets of inflammatory bowel disease and periodontitis gave 43 shared upregulated genes. Four machine learning algorithms (GLM, RF, GBM, SVM) were compared to select the best diagnostic model, identifying IGKC and COL4A1 as hub genes with the most diagnostic value, verified in a validation set and by qRT-PCR. Both genes were significantly downregulated during infliximab treatment of IBD patients in in vivo and in vitro experiments. The work shows association, and sample sizes are not stated in the abstract.
